title: InvenTrust Properties Corp. Announces First Quarter 2022 Earnings Release and Conference Call Dates
summary: InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today announced that it will report its first quarter 2022 earnings results on May 2, 2022, after the market closes. The Company’s earnings release and any supplemental information will be posted on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website – www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/ . InvenTrust will host an earnings conference call to discuss the Company’s results and business highlights on Tuesday, May 3, 2022, at 9:00 a.m. ET. An archive of the webcast will be available on the Company’s website.
